name: remote-mcp
description: Remote MCP Gateway — CDK stack + admin panel frontend

scripts.synth: pnpm build:frontend && pnpm --filter mcp-3lo-runtime-stack exec cdk synth GatewayStack --quiet
scripts.synth:firebase: pnpm --filter mcp-3lo-runtime-stack exec cdk synth FirebaseMcpRuntimeStack
scripts.diff: pnpm build:frontend && pnpm --filter mcp-3lo-runtime-stack exec cdk diff GatewayStack
scripts.deploy: pnpm build:frontend && pnpm --filter mcp-3lo-runtime-stack exec cdk deploy GatewayStack --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:firebase: pnpm --filter mcp-3lo-runtime-stack exec cdk deploy FirebaseMcpRuntimeStack --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:all: pnpm build:frontend && pnpm --filter mcp-3lo-runtime-stack exec cdk deploy --all --require-approval never
scripts.destroy: pnpm --filter mcp-3lo-runtime-stack exec cdk destroy GatewayStack --force
scripts.sync-targets: python3 bin/sync-mcp-targets.py create github && python3 bin/sync-mcp-targets.py create notion
